# Dilemma v3.4.0

New quizzes use illustrated cards and persistent Discord buttons. Option counts appear publicly after closing; players can spend Sparks to view a private preview while voting.

- Navy, lavender and gold cards show the question, 2-4 answer choices and voting duration. Topic and difficulty stay above the image. Full alternative text and a text fallback preserve access to the question.
- Random quizzes last at most 6 hours. AI receives the last 64 random topics per server as subjects to avoid, without a fixed category list. Normalized repeated topic titles are rejected within the existing retry budget.
- Players earn server-specific Sparks for correct answers and gained levels. The first vote is free. Changing or withdrawing an answer costs 1 Spark. Private counts and 50/50 each cost 5 Sparks once per quiz; reopening is free. The hint is unavailable with two answers.
- Bet 1-20 Sparks on the selected answer. The stake is deducted immediately. A correct answer returns 2x the stake in total. Bets follow answer changes; withdrawal refunds the stake and charges the 1-Spark withdrawal fee.
- Votes, rewards and payouts settle atomically and once. Privacy deletion removes a player's wallet, votes, hints and wagers. Existing native polls retain their original voting and settlement flow.

## Upgrade

Back up the database, apply `20261029120000_random_topics_sparks` and `20261029130000_button_quiz_tools`, regenerate the Prisma client and re-register Discord commands before using this version. Earlier upgrades also need all preceding migrations. Existing scores receive no historical Sparks backfill.

## Validation

The release is gated on isolated SQLite and PostgreSQL tests, concurrency and rollback checks, image rendering checks, type-checking, build, publication scans and CI on the deployed commit. Production verification covers migrations, registered commands, matching compiled code, Discord login and container security controls.
